paragraphs: Rabbi Yudan, son of Rabbi Shimon.
Mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah 4:2. At 5:2, Rabbi Berechiah reports in the name of Rabbi Yochan [יוחן], son of Rabbi Shimon. Perhaps the text should read R’ Y. [ר״י], son of Rabbi Simon.

notes.text: The source prints Yochan, while the consulted Bereshit Rabbah 5:2 has Yudan son of Rabbi Shimon. Hyman’s proposed ר״י remains unexpanded; his correction also changes Shimon to Simon. The cited chapters are 4 and 5, not 84 and 85.

The consulted scan of Hyman, volume II, printed p. 619, confirms יוחן in the second notice and the references to Bereshit Rabbah 4:2 and 5:2. The consulted digital texts name Rabbi Yudan son of Rabbi Shimon; 4:2 also separately names Rabbi Yehudah son of Rabbi Simon. Hyman’s proposed initials ר״י remain unexpanded, and his “perhaps” remains tentative. The printed and digital name forms are disclosed rather than harmonized or treated as an established identity.
